page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3g.2xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It features 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is bundled with a 479 GB local SSD, and network connectivity is defined by a 3 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.i3g.2xlarge primarily in the average tier for multi-core and memory operations. The instance achieved a multi-core stress-ng score of 7006.17 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4479.0. Memory bandwidth tests show stable throughput, reaching 391.14 GB/sec for small cached blocks and approximately 50.63 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. However, single-core performance is a notable tradeoff, with stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression scores falling into the bottom 25% tier.

Given its balanced resource allocation and integrated local SSD, this instance offers moderate resource density suitable for database operations, static web serving, and lightweight containerized applications. Passmark database operations scored 2855.44, and Redis SET operations reached 6.88 million operations per second, indicating solid capability for transactional workloads. While it handles small-scale language model inference adequately, performance drops significantly on medium-sized models, making it less suitable for complex AI tasks. The bundled local storage provides qualitative cost efficiency by eliminating the need for external block storage for temporary data.
